post.summary: Create a Kodex automation through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded automation creation endpoint. New self-control automations default to paused unless explicitly enabled, and provenance is stored durably.

patch.summary: Update a Kodex automation through self-control
patch.description: Agent-facing guarded automation update endpoint. It reuses gateway validation and only replaces stored provenance when a new self-control source is supplied.

post.summary: Pause a Kodex automation through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded automation pause endpoint that uses gateway-owned automation lifecycle policy and broadcasts.

post.summary: Resume a Kodex automation through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded automation resume endpoint that uses gateway-owned automation lifecycle policy and broadcasts.

post.summary: Apply desired preview proxy configuration through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded preview apply endpoint. It reconciles desired preview services, previews, and routes through gateway-owned policy and provenance instead of exposing raw preview CRUD semantics to MCP tools.

get.description: Agent-facing guarded self-control status endpoint. MCP tools use the /v1/self-control namespace instead of raw CRUD routes so gateway-owned policy, provenance, and audit behavior stay centralized.

post.summary: Create a Kodex thread through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded thread creation endpoint. It reuses gateway-owned thread creation policy, settings overlays, broadcasts, and provenance instead of raw app-server access.

post.summary: Send input to a Kodex thread through self-control
post.description: Agent-facing guarded thread input endpoint. It uses composer-equivalent gateway routing: idle threads start a turn and active threads receive source-labeled queued input.

get.summary: Preview a local skill icon image
get.description: Serves supported readable local skill icon images for localhost or trusted VPN deployments; this endpoint is not a public-safe filesystem authorization model.

415.description: Icon path exists but is not a supported image type

get.summary: Preview a local image or Markdown file
get.description: Serves supported readable local files for localhost or trusted VPN deployments; this endpoint is not a public-safe filesystem authorization model.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Thread id that owns the preview context

200.description: Local image or Markdown preview bytes

404.description: Thread or preview path was not found

415.description: Preview path exists but is not a supported preview type

name.description: Non-empty display name for the automation.

prompt.description: Non-empty prompt to enqueue into the target thread at each scheduled firing.
prompt.example: Summarize current repo state and next actions.

schedule.description: Initial schedule. startAt is an absolute instant; repeatEvery is a fixed duration.

targetThreadId.description: Target thread id that will receive the queued automation prompt.

nextRunAt.description: Next due firing instant in UTC.

unit.description: Interval unit. The gateway canonicalizes this to seconds for storage and scheduling.

value.description: Positive repeat interval value in the selected unit.

repeatEvery.description: Fixed-duration repeat interval. Accepted units are seconds, minutes, and hours; the effective interval must be at least 30 seconds.

startAt.description: Absolute RFC3339 timestamp for the first firing. Clients should send either a Z timestamp or an explicit UTC offset; the gateway normalizes and stores the instant in UTC. Fixed-duration repeats are not timezone or DST aware.

name.description: Replacement non-empty display name. Omit to keep the current name.

prompt.description: Replacement non-empty prompt. Omit to keep the current prompt.

oneOf.description: Replacement full schedule. When provided, the gateway resets nextRunAt to schedule.startAt.

targetThreadId.description: Replacement target thread id. Omit to keep the current target thread.

SelfControlSource.description:
Provenance supplied by Kodex Control MCP tools when they call guarded self-control endpoints.

Self-control endpoints are the agent-facing product boundary for Kodex-managed mutations.
MCP tools should use these routes instead of raw preview, thread, or automation CRUD routes so
gateway-owned policy, reconciliation, provenance, and audit behavior stay centralized.

reason.description: Short reason recorded in audit/provenance payloads.

oneOf.description: Whether the request was directly user-requested or agent-initiated.

sourceThreadId.description: Originating Kodex thread, when this request came from another thread.

sourceToolCallId.description: Originating MCP tool call id or equivalent agent tool invocation id.

sourceTurnId.description: Originating Kodex turn, when this request came from a specific turn.

sourceType.description: Self-control provenance marker. The only accepted value is `kodex_control`.

SelfControlSourceType.description: Allowed provenance source type for self-control requests.
